dataset_title: Fermentation chemistry of grass-clover and red-clover silage biorefinery fractions
source_title: Nutrient composition, fermentation characteristics and mass balance of press juice and press cake obtained from biorefining of grass-clover and red clover silage
source_table_caption: Concentration of volatile organic acids, ethanol, ammonia as well as pH in silage, press juice, fresh press cake and re-ensiled press cake produced from grass clover mixture (GCM) or red clover (RC).
license_status: Open-access article; exact Creative Commons subtype was not established from the accessible article copy. Do not assert a specific license for redistribution.
applicability: Measured process-fraction chemistry relevant to silage storage, green-juice characterization, and press-cake residual evaluation. Cultivated forage is not roadside grass and is not a GreenHub default.
limitations: Cultivated Austrian forage is not fresh Dutch roadside grass.
Table 3 reports concentrations, not stream mass flows or component recovery; do not derive emissions or reagent demand from these concentrations.
Ammonia concentration is not an emission factor or emitted NH3 flux.
pH does not determine titratable acidity or acid/base consumption.
Residual SD is copied as reported; table significance superscripts were not included in this extract.
No runtime equations or defaults are activated by this dataset.
